title: Tidepool Authentication API Deprecation
symptom: Tidepool has deprecated its legacy authentication API after replacing it with Keycloak, and the old endpoints are being retired. xDrip's current integration uses these deprecated endpoints and starts a new auth session every time a fresh token is needed instead of refreshing the session token directly.
cause: Tidepool replaced its legacy authentication system with Keycloak in December 2022, deprecating the old API endpoints. xDrip was using the old flow and creating a new auth session for each token instead of using refresh tokens.
fix: xDrip implemented the new OpenID Connect authorization code flow with refresh tokens against Tidepool's Keycloak server. After a Keycloak bug causing 'invalid_grant' logouts was fixed and deployed, the new authentication mechanism was switched on as the default in xDrip and released on September 23.
evidence_quote: @jamorham go ahead. The system has been stable since I notified you of the fix.
